title: Claude Code — Overview
description: Claude Code's own metrics and events, from the ClickHouse tables the Collector writes.

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.description: The repository name Claude Code derives from the origin remote; (none) for a session without one, or started without OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY=1.

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']) FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName LIKE 'claude_code.%' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.description: Claude Code's session.id; one per started or resumed session.

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT Attributes['session.id'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName LIKE 'claude_code.%' AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value)
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')

panels.description: Estimated by Claude Code from the token counts — not the invoice.

panels.title: Tokens

targets.rawSql:

FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum

panels.description: Input, output and both cache kinds together.

panels.title: Sessions

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value)
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.session.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')

panels.description: Sessions started in the window, fresh and resumed alike.

panels.title: Active time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value)
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.active_time.total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')

panels.description: Your typing plus Claude's working time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(Value)
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}') AND Attributes['type'] = 'added'

SELECT sum(Value)
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.commit.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['model'] AS model, sum(Value) AS cost
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY time, model
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tokens by type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['type'] AS type, sum(Value) AS tokens
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY time, type
ORDER BY time

panels.description: cacheRead dominating is the normal case: it is the prompt cache doing its job.

panels.title: Cost by project per hour

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfHour(TimeUnix, replaceOne('${__timezone}', 'utc', 'UTC')) AS time, if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']) AS project, sum(Value) AS cost
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY time, project
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Per day of the last 30 days, whatever the time range of the dashboard, with days in the time zone of the browser. The first bar covers only part of its day. The Project and Session filters apply.

panels.title: Cache hit rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time,
       sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'cacheRead') / nullIf(sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] IN ('input', 'cacheRead', 'cacheCreation')), 0) AS "Cache hit rate"
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Share of the input side served from the prompt cache: cacheRead over input, cacheRead and cacheCreation. A drop means context is being sent again at the full price.

panels.title: Cost per session

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LogAttributes['session.id'] AS "Session", min(Timestamp) AS "Started",
       dateDiff('second', min(Timestamp), max(Timestamp)) AS "Span", count() AS "Requests",
       sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_read_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_creation_tokens'])) AS "Tokens",
       sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd'])) AS "Cost"
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('api_request', 'claude_code.api_request')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Session"
ORDER BY "Cost" DESC

panels.description: API requests per session, most expensive first. Span runs from the first request to the last in the window, idle time included.

panels.title: Cost share by project and agent
panels.description: The share of each project and agent in the time range, largest first; a name alone is the project without a named subagent. Past seven slices, the smallest fold into Other.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(position <= 7, label, 'Other') AS "Project and agent", sum(value) AS "Cost"
FROM (SELECT label, value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS position
      FROM (SELECT if(Attributes['agent.name'] = '', if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), concat(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), ' / ', Attributes['agent.name'])) AS label, sum(Value) AS value
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
            GROUP BY label))
GROUP BY "Project and agent"
ORDER BY "Cost" DESC

panels.title: Token share by project and agent
panels.description: The share of each project and agent in the time range, largest first; a name alone is the project without a named subagent. Past seven slices, the smallest fold into Other.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(position <= 7, label, 'Other') AS "Project and agent", sum(value) AS "Tokens"
FROM (SELECT label, value, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY value DESC) AS position
      FROM (SELECT if(Attributes['agent.name'] = '', if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), concat(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), ' / ', Attributes['agent.name'])) AS label, sum(Value) AS value
            FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
            WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
            GROUP BY label))
GROUP BY "Project and agent"
ORDER BY "Tokens" DESC

panels.title: Cost by project and agent

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']) AS "Project", Attributes['query_source'] AS "Source",
       if(Attributes['agent.name'] = '', '-', Attributes['agent.name']) AS "Agent",
       uniqExact(Attributes['session.id']) AS "Sessions",
       sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage') AS "Tokens",
       sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage') AS "Cost"
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName IN ('claude_code.token.usage', 'claude_code.cost.usage') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND match(Attributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(Attributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', Attributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Project", "Source", "Agent"
ORDER BY "Cost" DESC

panels.description: Source is main, subagent or auxiliary. Agent is the subagent type; a user-defined one shows as custom unless OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1. Project is (none) for a session without an origin remote or started without OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY=1.

panels.title: Most expensive prompts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LogAttributes['prompt.id'] AS "Prompt", any(LogAttributes['session.id']) AS "Session", min(Timestamp) AS "Started",
       dateDiff('second', min(Timestamp), max(Timestamp)) AS "Span",
       countIf(LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('api_request', 'claude_code.api_request')) AS "Requests",
       countIf(LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('tool_result', 'claude_code.tool_result')) AS "Tool calls",
       sumIf(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['input_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['output_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_read_tokens']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['cache_creation_tokens']), LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('api_request', 'claude_code.api_request')) AS "Tokens",
       sumIf(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cost_usd']), LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('api_request', 'claude_code.api_request')) AS "Cost"
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE LogAttributes['prompt.id'] != ''
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Prompt"
ORDER BY "Cost" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: The 20 most expensive prompts of the window, with every API request and tool call each one set off. The text of a prompt is stored only with OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1; otherwise the start time and the session say which one it was.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time,
       quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS p50,
       quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS p95
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('api_request', 'claude_code.api_request')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT LogAttributes['status_code'] AS "Status", LogAttributes['error'] AS "Error",
       count() AS "Count", max(Timestamp) AS "Last"
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('api_error', 'claude_code.api_error')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Status", "Error"
ORDER BY "Count" DESC

SELECT LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS "Tool", count() AS "Calls",
       countIf(LogAttributes['success'] != 'true') AS "Failed",
       quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_ms'])) AS "p95"
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('tool_result', 'claude_code.tool_result')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Tool"
ORDER BY "Calls" DESC

panels.title: Permission decisions

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS "Tool", LogAttributes['decision'] AS "Decision",
       LogAttributes['source'] AS "Source", count() AS "Count"
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('tool_decision', 'claude_code.tool_decision')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Tool", "Decision", "Source"
ORDER BY "Count" DESC

panels.description: Source says who decided: config (an allow/deny rule), hook, or you.

panels.title: Tool result size

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LogAttributes['tool_name'] AS "Tool", count() AS "Calls", sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['tool_result_size_bytes'])) AS "Total",
       avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['tool_result_size_bytes'])) AS "Average", quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['tool_result_size_bytes'])) AS "p95", max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['tool_result_size_bytes'])) AS "Largest"
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('tool_result', 'claude_code.tool_result')
  AND mapContains(LogAttributes, 'tool_result_size_bytes')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Tool"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC

panels.description: What each tool puts into the context, largest share first. Sizes in bytes, not tokens. A call that reports no size, such as a failed one, is not counted.

panels.title: Hook duration

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LogAttributes['hook_name'] AS "Hook", count() AS "Runs", sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['total_duration_ms'])) AS "Total",
       quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['total_duration_ms'])) AS "p50", max(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['total_duration_ms'])) AS "Slowest",
       sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['num_blocking'])) AS "Blocked",
       sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['num_non_blocking_error']) + toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['num_cancelled'])) AS "Errors"
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('hook_execution_complete', 'claude_code.hook_execution_complete')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Hook"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC

panels.description: Claude Code's own hooks, the time a tool call waits on them. The git hooks of a repository are not here: they run inside a Bash call and count towards its duration.

panels.title: Slowest prompts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TraceId AS "Trace", min(Timestamp) AS "Started",
       maxIf(Duration, SpanName = 'claude_code.interaction') / 1000000 AS "Time",
       sumIf(Duration, SpanName = 'claude_code.llm_request') / 1000000 AS "Model",
       sumIf(Duration, SpanName = 'claude_code.tool.execution') / 1000000 AS "Tools",
       sumIf(Duration, SpanName = 'claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user') / 1000000 AS "Waiting",
       countIf(SpanName = 'claude_code.llm_request') AS "Requests",
       countIf(SpanName = 'claude_code.tool') AS "Tool calls"
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(SpanAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(SpanAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', SpanAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Trace"
HAVING "Time" > 0
ORDER BY "Time" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.description: The 20 slowest prompts, with the time in the model, in tools, and waiting for a permission decision. The three are added up over the spans, so calls that ran in parallel and subagents can make them exceed the time. A trace ID opens the trace.

panels.title: Waiting for approval

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SpanAttributes['decision'] AS "Decision", SpanAttributes['source'] AS "Source", count() AS "Calls",
       sum(Duration) / 1000000 AS "Total", quantile(0.5)(Duration) / 1000000 AS "p50", max(Duration) / 1000000 AS "Longest"
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE SpanName = 'claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(SpanAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(SpanAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', SpanAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
GROUP BY "Decision", "Source"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC

panels.description: How long tool calls waited for a permission decision, and who made it. Source config is a rule, so its time is not a person's; the other sources show where someone was asked.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp,
       arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(x -> x != '', [
           LogAttributes['event.name'], LogAttributes['tool_name'], LogAttributes['model'],
           LogAttributes['status_code']]), ' · ') AS body,
       SeverityText AS level,
       LogAttributes['session.id'] AS session
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'claude-code' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND match(LogAttributes['session.id'], '${session:regex}') AND match(if(LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name'] = '', '(none)', LogAttributes['vcs.repository.name']), '${project:regex}')
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500
